_comment: Ready-made looks for the captions graphic (0.4.6): values = settings its index.html declares (data-composition-variables), every look setting listed so switching from one to another leaves nothing behind. Apply: .venv\Scripts\python tools\overlay.py preset <folder> <id> (or captions ... --preset <id>). Sizes in px are for a 1080-px short side (1080x1920 or 1920x1080).

classic.label: Classic
classic.what: Heavy capitals with a black outline, the word being said in yellow, the whole line at once (the look before 0.4.6).

clean_box.label: Clean box
clean_box.what: Sentence case on a rounded, see-through dark box that fits its longest line, the word being said in cyan, each line fades in. Calm and readable on any footage (talking, explainers, podcasts).

keyword.label: Keyword
keyword.what: One or two small context words with ONE big keyword under them in the accent colour, in a serif italic - each word as it is said. Made for talking shorts: 2-3 words a caption.
